evidence.locator: Results, Progressive decorrelation of neural activity during learning; Fig. 2e–f
evidence.supports: Original registered result describes six population-correlation learning curves in 11 mice, with increases and decreases in different regions.

evidence.supports: Set A cohort, source binF observations, Cue Set A exclusions and region-wise correlation arithmetic. This conversion uses the retained notebook receipt and inspected implementation/documentation; no fresh raw Fig_2f notebook audit is claimed.

evidence.locator: Browsing the data; Data availability; Dependencies
evidence.supports: Author longitudinal registered-fluorescence route uses vr2p and Figshare 27273552, including multipart archives.
Registered task is longitudinal population-vector/correlation reconstruction; proposed animal-held-out model comparison is an extension.
Prepared-export Fig. 2f evaluator reconstructs correlations and source summaries, with no qualified prediction task or numeric paper success threshold.

evidence.locator: Methods population-vector analysis and Extended Data 7 description, as independently read in the accepted scope review
evidence.supports: The empirical interpretation rests on PV correlations/angles rather than UMAP appearance. Exact source mapping for state-versus-position and stability remains unresolved; this does not specify a new decoder or cross-day statistic.

target.description: Longitudinal hippocampal population decorrelation and state-specific versus position-based representation/stability from per-cell neural activity and matched behavior, including complete source-defined regional comparisons; no automatic whole-paper or every-figure requirement.

dataset.description: Original longitudinal hippocampal per-cell fluorescence/activity and matched behavior from the source learning experiment, with author Figshare article 27273552 version 1 native registered-fluorescence/place-field records. The complete native observation packet is not authenticated here; a stretched-trial subset or generated symbolic sequence is not the original longitudinal cohort.

cohort.description: The recorded Fig.2f Cue Set A roster is Tyche-A4, Tyche-A5, Tyche-A7, Tyche-B2, Tyche-B3, Tyche-B4, Tyche-B5, Tyche-C1, Tyche-D1, Tyche-F1, Tyche-F5. Each animal must retain its complete original session ledger and registered-cell/trial identities. Exact native completeness and figure-specific 97-session and first/last-session support remain unbound; 97 sessions are not 97 independent animals.

split.description: This is the original observational longitudinal analysis, not a train/test forecasting task. The retained Fig.2f route selects the initial consecutive sessions whose cue_sets are exactly [Cue Set A], stopping at the first other/mixed cue session and never restoring later Set A sessions. Native selection parity and the exact source supports for other retained contrasts remain unresolved. No held-animal predictive split is introduced.

inputs.description: Original native registered fluorescence, behavioral position/running/trial/cue/session information and source cell eligibility are required. The existing numerical interface accepts prepared safe NPZ records containing near_binF and far_binF, each registered cells by 46 bins, plus cell_ids, for Cue Set A/{1,2}/excl_no_response/{session}/putative. Its identical ordered cell-ID condition across days is conservative and requires source/native parity review; operator-declared binF provenance is insufficient.

preprocessing.description: Source mean fluorescence in 5-cm bins for running speed strictly greater than 5 cm/s, original putative-cell/no-response eligibility and cross-day registration must be authenticated from native observations. Near/far arrays preserve source undefined values. The retained component performs no native vr2p/Zarr export or fluorescence preprocessing. No invented spatial origin, bin center, registration selection or imputation is supplied.

metric.description: Reproduce complete near-by-far Pearson population correlations across matched cells (46 by 46 per eligible session), six literal masked arithmetic region means, and their complete learning trajectories. This is empirical geometry, not a reward score or universal decorrelation objective. The exact original state-specific-versus-position and stability contrasts, complete numerical references and justified scientific comparison criteria remain unresolved.

aggregation.description: For each animal/region, ordinary masked means propagate NaN; remove NaN days before placing valid values evenly on [0,1] and interpolating 1000 inclusive coordinates, compressing missing-day gaps. Fewer than two valid days leaves an undefined curve. Keep all eleven animals in equal-animal group mean and source std(ddof=0)/sqrt(11) SEM, including undefined propagation. Source SEM is descriptive, not a reproduction tolerance or an uncertainty policy; 1000 interpolated coordinates and six regions are not independent animals. Exact other contrast/uncertainty aggregation remains unbound.

full_panel.description: Require all eligible sessions of every recorded Fig.2f animal, full 46-by-46 PV matrices, all six source regions including increasing, decreasing and unchanged/end-null patterns, valid-day counts, every animal trajectory and group mean/source SEM. The two indexed families below represent that known numerical route only. Exact source mapping and indispensable sensory/task-context/registration controls for the retained state-versus-position and learning-stability claims remain mandatory unresolved coverage; the prepared evaluator does not implement direct day-to-day PV stability. Preserve distinct 97-session and first/last supports. Do not add every figure, a new decoder, a held-animal split or all model simulations. A separately claimed mechanistic model explanation requires source-defined representation/learning-dynamics comparators; reward performance alone is insufficient.

permitted_observations.description: The authentic longitudinal neural observations and matched behavior needed for source-defined descriptive/representational analyses are permitted. The empirical task is not blind forecasting. Original cell/session/trial/cue identities and source exclusions must be authenticated. The paper+data versus paper+data+author-code conditions would differ only in supplied author code under matched source input/exposure/budget policies; those protocols are unavailable. ED9 generated symbols and model reward recall remain separately named secondary simulation evidence.

findings.description: Complete source near/far population geometry at each original eligible session for all eleven recorded animals. Session counts and native identities are unresolved; known 46-by-46 dimensions do not authenticate observations or reproduce the full empirical primary.
